title: Employer Portal and Integration Access by Tier — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Fact Sheet
content:
How an employer reaches the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service — administrator seats, API sending, batch file upload and the portal roles that may act on the service — is set per tier.

| Tier | Employer administrator seats included | Disbursements through the API | Disbursements by batch file upload | Portal roles allowed to send, recall and close |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Instant Pay Starter | 1 | no | no | program owner; payroll admin |
| Paystride Instant Pay Core | 2 | no | yes | program owner; payroll admin |
| Paystride Instant Pay Growth | 5 | yes | yes | program owner; payroll admin |
| Paystride Instant Pay Pro | 10 | yes | yes | program owner; payroll admin |
| Paystride Instant Pay Scale | 25 | yes | yes | program owner; payroll admin |
| Paystride Instant Pay Enterprise | 50 | yes | yes | program owner; payroll admin |

- **Seats** — employer administrator seats included (count).
- **API access** — whether disbursements may be sent through the API.
- **Batch file upload** — whether disbursements may be uploaded as a batch file.
- **Authorized requester roles** — employer portal roles allowed to send, recall and close; the same two roles are listed on every tier.

API sending starts at Growth; batch file upload starts at Core.
